name: Raven Channel Video
summary: Records the videos of the RavenRS channel from the real apps: it drives them as a person would, narrates the boxes with the local Kokoro voice and writes the wide and vertical videos, subtitles, chapters and cover.
when_to_use: To record a new video of the channel, or record one again after the apps changed.
To look at single moments of a film as pictures before exporting.

commands.does: Records what the boxes say with the local voice (pf_dora, pm_alex or pm_santa).
Writes the wide and the vertical video, the subtitles, the chapters and a cover.
Builds the screens it records with no window; exit code 0 when they draw.

limits: It has no window: it is run from the terminal.
The voice needs the local models (FF_AI_MODELS).
